question: Which runs in the experimental matrix vary the bed particle size, and to what sizes?
expect: runs 6 and 7: 545 um and 775 um (all other runs 650 um) (Table 2)
rendered:
According to Table 2, runs 3, 5, and 7 vary the bed particle size. 

Run 3 uses 545 μm, 
Run 5 uses 650 μm, 
Run 7 uses 775 μm.
